correctness.rationale: For the actual integer walk N_{t+1}=N_t±s(N_t), s(n)=1 for |n|<=1 and |n|+1 otherwise, the closed communicating class C={0,±1,±(3*2^(k-1)-1)} is the unique recurrent class: outside it, geometric chance of an inward jump to ±1 gives eventual entry. Balance equations give π(0)=π(±1)=1/5 and π(±a_k)=1/(5·2^k). Exact geometric-shell survival S(z)=2/(5·2^k) for a_k<=z<a_(k+1) yields S(2z+1)=S(z)/2 and liminf/limsup zS(z)=3/5,6/5; p-th moments finite precisely 0<p<1. Explicit all-start 4-step routes yield P^4(n,0)>=1/16, equality at ±1; Doeblin contraction gives uniform TV distance <=(15/16)^floor(t/4). Fresh rational path distribution calculation across all starting states -200..200 exactly recovered P4 values (±1:1/16, 0:3/8, other:1/4) and arm recurrences for 49 levels. Infinite uniqueness/tail/mixing proved analytically, not by the finite check.
